scope: Local sequential queries on TT. The Mercury span uses guarded endpoints inside parent coverage. Full returned payloads, including numerical brackets, residuals, clipping, unresolved tails and evaluation counts, must agree exactly. These are consistency and cost measurements, not independent astronomical accuracy evidence.
